Name: Memorial Plaza
Desc: Though only half of it remains, it is one of the legacies Dominik left in Babylonia, and a spiritual pillar for countless F.O.S. personnel. A small sculpture beneath the monument shows its complete form, constantly reminding people of its former appearance.

Name: Domain Training Grounds
Desc: A specialized training space that utilizes holographic projection and biomimetic simulation technology to construct highly realistic battle scenarios. It serves as the core site for students to conduct tactical drills, combat practice, and co-op training.

Name: Angled Corridor
Desc: A large airborne platform within F.O.S., connecting the monument and the Golden Hall. The entire history of F.O.S has been inscribed on the stone tablets scattered throughout the plaza.

Name: Golden Hall
Desc: The large auditorium used for major assemblies within the college. Majestic and solemn, it has welcomed every class since the college was founded, where students gather to pledge themselves to humanity's future.

Name: Transportation Hub
Desc: Recreational districts on the two sides of the street, frequently visited by students who are looking to relax during their free time. The area is equipped with living facilities, logistics conveyor belts, and other basic infrastructure, along with benches and other leisure spaces.

Name: Tactical Training
Desc: A tactical simulation program from F.O.S., officially named the Spear of F.O.S. Tactical Interface. It offers support on military decision-making to all authorized personnel by creating combat simulations, tactical assessments, optimization recommendations, and more.

Name: Spectrum Garden
Desc: A small recreational garden outside F.O.S. Military Command College. The central device projects the F.O.S. school crest, where technological light patterns interweave with the greenery, creating a tranquil corner for students to relax during their free time.
